panels.panel_visual_description: A young woman is framed in a close-up, selfie-style shot, looking directly into the camera. She has long dark hair parted down the middle and is wearing a blue and white vertically striped button-down shirt. The background is a softly blurred outdoor setting, likely a rooftop or balcony, with hints of trees and buildings under a dusk sky. The lighting is soft and natural, evenly illuminating her face without harsh shadows. She maintains steady eye contact with the camera lens. Her facial expressions change subtly, shifting between thoughtful, skeptical, and smiling as if engaged in an active conversation. The camera remains completely static throughout the entire sequence, holding the tight framing on her face and shoulders.

scenes.visual_description: The scene is presented as a simulated video call interface on a mobile phone screen. The main video feed displays a young woman standing outdoors on a rooftop at dusk. Overlaid on the top right of the video are chat bubbles that appear sequentially, alternating between dark blue 'You' bubbles and green 'AI Feedback' bubbles. These bubbles display the ongoing conversation text in Kannada script. A circular blue robot icon is positioned on the upper left side of the screen, representing the AI tutor. At the bottom of the screen, a dark translucent bar houses standard video call control icons, including a camera toggle, microphone mute, a red end-call button, an add-user icon, and a more-options menu. The overall layout mimics a modern smartphone communication app.
scenes.audio_transcript:
Character A says: ನನಗೆ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಓದೋಕೆ ಬರೆಯೋಕೆ ಬರುತ್ತೆ. [I know how to read and write English.]
Character B says: ಆಯ್ತು ಕಣೆ, ಮಾತಾಡೋಕೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾ? [Okay, do you know how to speak?]
Character A says: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬರುತ್ತೆ ಅಷ್ಟೇ. [Only a little bit.]
Character B says: ನಿನಗೆ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತಾಡೋಕೆ ನಾಚಿಕೆ ಆಗುತ್ತಾ? [Do you feel shy to speak in English?]
Character A says: ಹೌದು ಕಣೆ. [Yes.]
Character B says: ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಗಳು ಟ್ರೈ ಮಾಡಿದೀಯಾ? [Have you tried any courses?]
Character A says: ಟ್ರೈ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರು ಉಪಯೋಗ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಸುಮ್ನೆ ದುಡ್ಡು ಯಾಕೆ ವೇಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡ್ಲಿ. [Even if I try, it's of no use, why waste money.]
Character B says: AI training? [AI training?]
Character A says: AI ಟ್ರೈನಿಂಗ್ ಆ? ಏನ್ ಕಣೆ ತಮಾಷೆ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದೀಯಾ? [AI training? Are you joking?]
Character B says: ಒಂದ್ ಸರಿ MySivi ಟ್ರೈ ಮಾಡಿ ನೋಡು ಆಮೇಲೆ ಮಾತಾಡು. [Try MySivi once and then talk.]
Character A says: ಸರಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಜಾಯಿನ್ ಆಗ್ಬೇಕು? [Okay, how to join?]
Character B says: MySivi ಇನ್ಸ್ಟಾಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಂಡ್ರೆ, ನನ್ ಅಂತಹ AI ಟ್ರೈನರ್ಸ್ ಪರ್ಸನಲೈಸ್ಡ್ ಟ್ರೈನಿಂಗ್ ಕೊಡ್ತಾರೆ. [If you install MySivi, AI trainers like me will give personalized training.]
Character A says: ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಆಗ್ತಿಲ್ಲ ಗುರು. [I can't believe it, man.]
Character B says: ಮೊದಲು ಟ್ರೈ ಮಾಡಿ ನೋಡು ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ ನಂಬು. MySivi ಇಂದ ಕಳೆದ ಎರಡು ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಇವತ್ತು ಲಕ್ಷ ಜನ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಪ್ರಾಕ್ಟೀಸ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಇವಾಗ್ಲೇ. Sivi Pro ಜಾಯಿನ್ ಆಗಿ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಟ್ರೈನಿಂಗ್ ಶುರು ಮಾಡು. [First try and see, then believe. Through MySivi in the last two years, today lakhs of people are practicing English right now. Join Sivi Pro and start English training.]
